<!--
One template for all ticket types. Title: `<epic> / US-n <short description>`, e.g. `P-17 / US-2 Palette and type scale`.
Without an epic or story (a bug, a chore), use just the short description.
Labels: `enhancement` for features, `bug` for bugs, `documentation` for docs-only work.
Delete the guidance comments when filling it in; omit "Related" if empty.
-->

## Context
<!--
Why this is needed: the epic and user story (`P-17 / US-2`, with a link to the epic file), what exists today, what is missing.
Bug: steps to reproduce, expected behaviour, actual behaviour, environment; say which parts of the cause are confirmed and which are guesses.
-->

## Goal
<!-- One or two sentences: the outcome when this is done. -->

## Implementation notes
<!--
- Files / modules: `path/...`
- Approach: a few bullets with the decisions already made (link the D-nn entries).
-->

## Acceptance criteria
<!-- Checkable criteria, verified in the code, with a command or by a manual step. -->
- [ ] AC1:

## Related
<!-- Epic and decision docs, linked tickets and PRs, logs. -->

## Suggested model
<!-- Tier sized to the scope, with confidence and a one-line reason, e.g.:
**Sonnet 5.5** (confidence: High). Self-contained change in one package, clear requirements. -->
